description: This Kotlin source file defines the VoiceWakeManager class, which manages voice recognition for wake-word detection and command processing using Android's SpeechRecognizer API. It handles starting, stopping, and restarting the speech recognition service, processes speech recognition results, and triggers callback functions upon command detection.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManager
classes.description: Manages voice wake-word detection and command recognition, handling speech recognition lifecycle events, restart logic, and invoking callback with detected commands.

methods.name: setTriggerWords
methods.description: Sets the list of trigger words that activate command processing.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the speech recognition process, initializing recognizer and listening.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops speech recognition and updates status.

methods.name: startListeningInternal
methods.description: Internal method to initiate listening with configured intent.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of the listening process after a delay.

methods.name: handleTranscription
methods.description: Handles recognized speech, extracts commands, and triggers callbacks.
